svg.title: laneq lease state machine
svg.desc: A pushed directive begins pending. An atomic take records a consumer and lease and moves it to taken. Touch renews the lease. Reaping an observed expired or stale lease and explicit requeue return work to pending and increment the requeue count. A deferred item returns to pending after its time gate is ready and named dependencies are terminal. Park moves a taken item to the parked state and unpark returns it to pending. Setting status to done or dropped creates terminal states. The generic status setter is permissive, so this depicts the normal claimed-work path rather than an enforced transition-authorization model.
